# Clash of Critters Companion

> An unofficial community companion with public game guides, tools and Community links.

## Public pages

- [Tatari Database | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/database/tatari.html): Browse Tatari evolutions, elements, classes and skills. Compare the published game data and check the version notes before planning upgrades.
- [Formation Planner | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/drafter/horde.html): Build and share Clash of Critters formations, review team skills and plan Tatari placement with the companion formation tool.
- [Tatari Tier List Maker | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/drafter/tierlist.html): Create and share your own Tatari tier list using Clash of Critters artwork. Your rankings are community opinions, not official ratings.
- [Cozy Farm Guide | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/events/cozy-farm.html): Understand Cozy Farm growth, support bonuses, fertilizer, watering and milestones. Check the guide version and assumptions before planning.
- [Fishing Contest Guide | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/events/fishing.html): Learn how the Fishing Contest works, review fishing equipment and rewards, and plan progress using the companion guide.
- [Horde Invasion Guide | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/events/horde.html): Review Horde Invasion mechanics, Energy Candy, chips and team planning. Check seasonal notes and documented uncertainties before choosing a build.
- [Island Goldrush Guide | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/events/island-goldrush.html): Learn Island Goldrush team planning, event rules and rewards. Review the companion guide and confirm current event details in game.
- [Event Team Finder | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/events/matchmaking.html): Find community teammates for Clash of Critters events. Review event timing and coordinate with players through the companion site.
- [Raft Race Guide | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/events/raft-race.html): Explore Raft Race mechanics, Tatari planning and rewards with a version-aware Clash of Critters community guide.
- [Sparkly Spa Guide | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/events/sparkly-spa.html): Learn about Sparkly Spa access, Spa Soap, T4 Tatari effects and Sparkle appearances. Review the source version and guide limitations.
- [Treasure Hunt Guide | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/events/treasure-hunt.html): Understand Treasure Hunt mechanics, tools and rewards, then use the companion solver to plan your next dig.
- [Zobo Shooter Guide | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/events/zobo-shooter.html): Review Zobo Shooter mechanics, rewards and planning tips. Check the current guide version before applying event-specific advice.
- [Farm Support UID Directory | Clash of Critters](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/farm-support.html): Find community-submitted Farm Support UIDs and compare listed bonuses. Listings are reviewed by site admins and are not official game verification.
- [Community Formations | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/formations.html): Browse player-shared Clash of Critters formations for ideas. Community builds reflect their authors and should be checked against the current game version.
- [Clash of Critters Companion | Guides, Tools & Codes](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/): Plan your Clash of Critters progress with Tatari guides, formation tools, event schedules, redeem codes and community card exchange.
- [Clash of Critters Creators | Artiar & Community Videos](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/information/creators.html): Explore Clash of Critters videos from featured creators, including Artiar. Visit their channels and copy an available in-game creator code.
- [Clash of Critters Patch Notes & Upcoming Updates](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/information/patch-notes.html): Read published Clash of Critters update notes, check release dates and follow original announcements. Future-dated entries are marked as upcoming.
- [Clash of Critters Redeem Codes | Community Reports](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/information/redeem-codes.html): Copy Clash of Critters redeem codes, review listed rewards and see community Working or Not working reports. Availability may vary by account.
- [Pinball Calculator | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/resources.html): Estimate Clash of Critters Pinball resources with the companion calculator. Compare ranges and assumptions; results are estimates, not guarantees.
- [Event Schedule & Reset Timers | Clash of Critters](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/schedule.html): Check the Clash of Critters event calendar, registration windows and reset timers. Confirm current in-game announcements for schedule changes.
- [Tatari Stats Calculator | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/tatari-stats.html): Compare Tatari stats across evolutions, stars, food and dojo settings. Review calculation assumptions and the published data version.
- [Community Tatari Tier Lists | Clash of Critters](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/tierlists.html): Explore player-created Tatari tier lists and different ranking approaches. These rankings are community opinions, not official recommendations.
- [Card Exchange Finder | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/trading.html): Find collectors with matching spare cards, compare trade preferences and arrange exchanges in game. The companion site does not transfer game items.
- [Treasure Hunt Solver | Clash of Critters Companion](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/treasure-solver.html): Mark your Treasure Hunt discoveries and compare estimated dig chances. Solver results depend on the selected layout and recorded observations.

## Scope and accuracy

These links lead to public HTML pages. Follow their source versions, formulas and uncertainty notes. Community formations and tier lists represent player opinions. Live codes and patch notes may change; consult the published pages for current entries. The exchange finder helps players arrange exchanges in game and does not transfer items.

Private accounts, chats, player inventories, administration, drafts and unfinished pages are excluded from this index. This file is a discovery aid, not an access control or a guarantee of accuracy.

- [Patch 165921 findings](https://kenzkunz.github.io/tatari-companion/information/patch-165921.html): Reconstructed config evidence for Bonobean, account levels through 3600 and Horde S3 Difficulties 1–6. Exact live payload identity is unverified; Horde wave/chip tools now use S3 patch-165921 data.

Horde patch 165921: six difficulties, 150 waves and 71 English-localized Zobo types; chip balance and existing skill details are integrated. Bonobean skill references are included in the Horde guide. The exact live payload identity and new parameter meanings remain unverified.
